requirements.title: Mission execution
requirements.description: The robot shall execute warehouse transport missions from pickup through delivery.
requirements.rationale: End-to-end mission execution is the core operational capability.

requirements.title: Payload capacity
requirements.description: The robot shall transport payloads weighing up to 500 kg on approved floor surfaces.
requirements.rationale: A defined capacity supports safe selection of the robot for each task.

requirements.title: Throughput target
requirements.description: The fleet shall support at least 120 completed transport missions per hour in the high-throughput configuration.
requirements.rationale: A measurable throughput target enables capacity planning.

requirements.title: Operating environment
requirements.description: The robot shall operate on indoor warehouse floors between 5 C and 40 C.
requirements.rationale: Environmental limits define the validated operating envelope.

requirements.title: Subsystem interfaces
requirements.description: The control software shall exchange typed commands and status with each robot subsystem.
requirements.rationale: Stable interfaces reduce coupling between subsystem implementations.

requirements.title: Operational state model
requirements.description: The robot shall expose Idle, Ready, Executing, Paused, and Faulted operational states.
requirements.rationale: A common state model keeps operator and subsystem behavior consistent.

requirements.title: Diagnostic event model
requirements.description: The robot shall assign each diagnostic event a code, severity, timestamp, and source subsystem.
requirements.rationale: Structured events support troubleshooting and fleet analysis.

requirements.title: Velocity control
requirements.description: The motion controller shall regulate commanded linear velocity within 5 percent of the requested value on a level floor.
requirements.rationale: Accurate velocity control is required for predictable navigation.

requirements.title: Steering control
requirements.description: The motion controller shall follow steering commands without exceeding the validated turning radius.
requirements.rationale: Bounded steering behavior prevents collisions in narrow aisles.

requirements.title: Braking control
requirements.description: The motion controller shall stop the robot within 0.6 m from 1.0 m/s on a dry level floor.
requirements.rationale: A bounded stopping distance is needed for safe operation.

requirements.title: Load handling interlock
requirements.description: The robot shall inhibit movement when a load-handling mechanism is not in its travel-safe position.
requirements.rationale: The interlock prevents movement with an unstable load.

requirements.title: Wheel slip detection
requirements.description: The motion controller shall detect wheel slip when measured wheel speed differs from estimated ground speed by more than 15 percent for 200 ms.
requirements.rationale: Early detection allows the robot to reduce torque before losing control.

requirements.title: Motion watchdog
requirements.description: The motion controller shall enter a controlled stop if command updates are absent for 250 ms.
requirements.rationale: A watchdog limits motion after a control task failure.

requirements.title: Fault reporting
requirements.description: Each subsystem shall publish active faults and their recovery state through the diagnostic event model.
requirements.rationale: Consistent fault reporting supports service and operations.

requirements.title: Diagnostic log retention
requirements.description: The robot shall retain at least 30 days of diagnostic events or 10000 events, whichever is reached first.
requirements.rationale: A retained history supports analysis of intermittent faults.

requirements.title: Service access
requirements.description: Authorized service personnel shall be able to export diagnostic events without disabling safety functions.
requirements.rationale: Service access should not interfere with safe operation.

requirements.title: Navigation mission input
requirements.description: The navigation subsystem shall accept a destination expressed as a mapped station or waypoint identifier.
requirements.rationale: Consistent mission input allows warehouse systems to dispatch work.

requirements.title: Route execution
requirements.description: The navigation subsystem shall follow a collision-free route and report progress at least once per second.
requirements.rationale: Progress updates support supervision and recovery.

requirements.title: Pose estimate
requirements.description: The robot shall estimate its planar position and heading with a 95th-percentile position error below 0.10 m in mapped aisles.
requirements.rationale: Accurate pose estimation is required for aisle navigation.

requirements.title: Sensor fusion
requirements.description: The localization subsystem shall fuse wheel odometry with at least one independent environmental sensor.
requirements.rationale: Sensor fusion reduces drift from any single measurement source.

requirements.title: Localization confidence
requirements.description: The localization subsystem shall publish a confidence value with every pose estimate.
requirements.rationale: Consumers need confidence information to handle uncertain positions.

requirements.title: Localization loss detection
requirements.description: The robot shall declare localization degraded when pose confidence remains below the configured threshold for 1 second.
requirements.rationale: Prompt detection prevents the robot from acting on unreliable position data.

requirements.title: Relocalization recovery
requirements.description: After localization is degraded, the robot shall attempt relocalization while stationary before resuming autonomous motion.
requirements.rationale: Stationary recovery reduces the risk of motion from a false pose.

requirements.title: Path obstacle handling
requirements.description: The path planner shall stop or replan when an obstacle blocks the next 2 m of the active route.
requirements.rationale: Dynamic obstacle handling prevents unsafe route continuation.

requirements.title: Path clearance
requirements.description: The path planner shall maintain at least 0.15 m clearance from mapped static obstacles.
requirements.rationale: Clearance accounts for localization and vehicle footprint uncertainty.

requirements.title: Aisle passing policy
requirements.description: The path planner shall not schedule two robots to pass in a single-width aisle at the same time.
requirements.rationale: Aisle reservation avoids deadlock and close-proximity encounters.

requirements.title: Route cost selection
requirements.description: The path planner shall select among feasible routes using distance, congestion, and battery reserve.
requirements.rationale: A balanced cost function supports efficient and robust missions.

requirements.title: Safety operating envelope
requirements.description: The robot shall prevent commanded motion outside its validated speed, payload, and environmental limits.
requirements.rationale: Operating limits bound hazards during normal operation.

requirements.title: Protective stop
requirements.description: The safety controller shall stop motion when a person is detected inside the configured protective field.
requirements.rationale: Protective stopping reduces the risk of person-robot contact.

requirements.title: Safety controller independence
requirements.description: The safety controller shall be able to remove drive torque without relying on the mission-planning software.
requirements.rationale: Independent stopping prevents a software planning fault from defeating protection.

requirements.title: Protective field selection
requirements.description: The safety controller shall select a protective field appropriate to the current commanded speed.
requirements.rationale: Speed-dependent fields provide protection while avoiding unnecessary stops.

requirements.title: Safety input monitoring
requirements.description: The safety controller shall detect an open circuit or short circuit on each safety-rated input.
requirements.rationale: Input diagnostics help detect faults that could impair protective functions.

requirements.title: Safety function test
requirements.description: At startup, the robot shall verify that safety-rated inputs and the drive stop path respond within their specified test limits.
requirements.rationale: Startup checks identify safety function failures before operation.

requirements.title: Safety fault latching
requirements.description: A safety fault shall remain latched until the fault is cleared and an authorized reset is performed.
requirements.rationale: Latching prevents automatic restart after a safety event.

requirements.title: Emergency stop response
requirements.description: Pressing any emergency stop device shall remove drive torque and activate the audible and visual alarms.
requirements.rationale: An immediate, recognizable response is essential in an emergency.

requirements.title: Emergency stop reset
requirements.description: Resetting an emergency stop device shall not restart motion without a separate start command.
requirements.rationale: A deliberate restart prevents unexpected movement.

requirements.title: Emergency event record
requirements.description: The robot shall record the time, active mission, and safety state when an emergency stop is activated.
requirements.rationale: Event context supports investigation and corrective action.

requirements.title: Energy reserve
requirements.description: The robot shall reserve enough battery energy to reach a designated charging station before starting a mission.
requirements.rationale: A reserve prevents the robot from stopping in an unsafe or obstructive location.

requirements.title: Charging station interface
requirements.description: The robot shall detect correct alignment and charging status at a compatible charging station.
requirements.rationale: Verified alignment prevents failed or interrupted charging.

requirements.title: Battery state estimate
requirements.description: The battery manager shall publish state of charge with an estimated error below 5 percent over the validated temperature range.
requirements.rationale: Reliable state of charge supports mission planning and charging decisions.

requirements.title: Battery temperature protection
requirements.description: The battery manager shall inhibit charging outside the battery supplier temperature limits.
requirements.rationale: Temperature limits protect battery life and reduce thermal hazards.

requirements.title: Battery health reporting
requirements.description: The battery manager shall report state of health and the number of completed charge cycles.
requirements.rationale: Health reporting supports maintenance and capacity planning.

requirements.title: Low energy recovery
requirements.description: When energy reserve falls below the configured threshold, the robot shall finish or safely suspend its current task and navigate to charging.
requirements.rationale: A defined recovery policy avoids unexpected power loss.

requirements.title: Fleet communication
requirements.description: The robot shall exchange mission, status, and fault messages with the fleet manager over the approved wireless network.
requirements.rationale: Reliable fleet communication enables coordinated operations.

requirements.title: Communication loss response
requirements.description: If fleet communication is lost for more than 3 seconds, the robot shall enter the configured communication-loss behavior.
requirements.rationale: A bounded response prevents unsafe continuation with stale instructions.

requirements.title: Command authentication
requirements.description: The robot shall authenticate fleet-manager commands before accepting mission or configuration changes.
requirements.rationale: Authentication prevents unauthorized control of the robot.

requirements.title: Command freshness
requirements.description: The robot shall reject control commands older than the configured command-validity interval.
requirements.rationale: Freshness checks prevent delayed commands from changing current behavior.

requirements.title: Communication recovery
requirements.description: After a network interruption, the robot shall reconcile mission state with the fleet manager before accepting new work.
requirements.rationale: State reconciliation prevents duplicate or conflicting missions.

comments.title: Cold-storage battery limits
comments.comment: Validate the cold-storage temperature envelope with the battery supplier.

comments.title: Pose confidence threshold
comments.comment: Confirm the pose confidence threshold against the production sensor set.

comments.title: Protective field commissioning
comments.comment: Safety field dimensions require approval during site commissioning.
